methodology.purpose: Timing and risk overlay only; never changes valuation readiness.
methodology.history_window: up to five years of adjusted daily OHLCV

explainers.risk: Calibrated on 1990-2017; holdout 2018-2026 AUC 0.66 for a further 15% drop (panic alone 0.52).
explainers.rebound: Risk-adjusted rank among US dashboard stocks: expected next-month return after removing each stock's market (beta) component. Holdout 2018-2026: top tenth beat bottom tenth by ~1.4% a month on that basis before ~1.2% round-trip costs. It leans to lower-beta, steadier names and does not predict beating SPY in a rising market (raw SPY-relative IC ~0.01, not significant).
explainers.context: Recent moves split into the beta-explained (market) part and the rest (company).

outlook.trained_on: 1990-2017 US dashboard stock-days (every 5th session), holdout 2018-2026 untouched

cnn_reference.label: CNN Fear & Greed
cnn_reference.note: External market-sentiment reference; not blended into stock scores.
